asks: The LIST behind these two counts. s68 asks for the number "and list" of outstanding requests and of records awaiting transfer. The count needs only a status; the list needs a request record with a requester, a date and an item on it, and no system this report reaches holds one.

"Can room capacity and % available storage capacity be included?" This is the client's own question, put to us on s68, and it is left as a question. A capacity bar was drawn here until 24 August with a made up 65, 80 and 45 per cent, which answered their open question with an invention. Capacity needs a room, a shelf measure and a fill level, none of which exists in any source this report holds.
The LIST behind the outstanding requests count, as on the storage screen. A count needs a status; a list needs a request record with a requester, a date and an item on it.

"Can room activities here update the capacity and % available storage capacity (freed up storage)?" The client's own question, put to us on s69, and left as a question. It cannot be answered before the capacity question on s68 is, because there is no capacity figure for a disposal to free up.

The summary band on s69 reads "boxes stored" and "folders stored" above a table whose own columns read "retrieved", on a slide titled Retrieval. Read as a copy paste in the deck and drawn as "retrieved" to match the table. Worth one line of confirmation from the client.
